title: Item grants: non-anchored cooldownEconomy grants bind without their spend (Bag of Tricks, elemental vessels, Pipes, Horn, goat)
description: Found by eshyra-olc5.12.2. The captain rule 'binding requires the cooldownEconomy spent (remaining 0, no availableAt)' is literally wrong for multi-use economies: Bag of Tricks uses is per-day 3 uses (remaining 2 after one pull is a legitimate bind), and Pipes charges, elemental-vessel uses, Horn cooldown (7-day, no grant-ended anchor) and goat-of-traveling hour charges are not grant-anchored. The coupling was therefore scoped to grants whose cooldown economy has startsOn grant-ended for that grant (grantCooldownAnchoredTo in itemState.ts). Remaining gap: these grants bind without any spend, and nothing ties a pull or charge to the bind. Needs a pending-bind model for multi-use economies (design decision) or a documented decision that these binds stay DM-adjudicated. Source: magicItemUseEconomies.ts, pack records bag-of-tricks, horn-of-valhalla, pipes-of-the-sewers, bowl/brazier/censer/stone elementals, figurine goat-of-traveling.
notes: 2026-10-17: PR #669 (stacking half of xt6m; the readiness half is with c58j). Captain-verified 6987 passed. Stays in_progress until merge.
